categories.hint: Win together if the scenario goal is met within the round limit

categories.label: Victory points (scenario table)
categories.hint: Total from the Victory Points table on the scenario card; counted even on a loss

winCondition: Players win immediately by fulfilling the scenario goal within the available rounds. Players lose immediately if any character dies, or when the last round ends without the goal fulfilled.
notes: family: coop. Victory points are optional, only for tracking progress and comparing across plays (recorded in the Results diary); the VP table differs per scenario and player count and is printed only on the scenario card, so it is a scorer input. Not comparable across player counts.
